listen_address.description: D-Bus transport address to listen on; typically a Unix domain socket path.

systemd_socket_activation.description: If true, enable systemd socket activation for improved startup performance and resource management.

system_services.description: List of system services requiring custom policy rules. Each entry defines a service and its allowed D-Bus operations.

uid.description: Numeric UID or service username under which the service runs (e.g., 'root', 'systemd-network').

well_known_name.description: Well-known D-Bus name (e.g., 'org.freedesktop.NetworkManager') the service owns and communicates on.

trusted_services.description: List of trusted system services (e.g., init, systemd) requiring elevated privileges. Each entry defines a service's D-Bus name.

name.description: Human-readable name of the trusted service.

well_known_name.description: Well-known D-Bus name (e.g., 'org.freedesktop.systemd1') granted elevated access.

includedir.description: Directory containing additional .conf fragments to include in the bus configuration.

log_destination.description: Where to send D-Bus daemon log output (syslog, file, or stderr).

limits_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed.

limits_max_replies.description: Maximum number of reply messages a single connection may have queued at once.

limits_max_message_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of a single D-Bus message (default: 128 KiB).

shutdown_on_disconnect.description: If true, shut down the D-Bus daemon when the last client disconnects. Dangerous in production.
